reason: I resell, so I need margin. 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes means I'd pay 51,000 for something I can pick up in Shorja for less today, and I'd wait three weeks for it. Plus I've never seen anyone on TikTok unbox an order from these guys.
objection: The fees eat everything I could make reselling, and it's a new name with no reviews or unboxing videos, so I'd be paying up front to people I can't vouch for.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate for bulk reseller orders, plus a few real unboxing videos from people I follow showing the stuff arrived as ordered.
